arms.name: run_resolve_weather
arms.doc: 🧱️ Copies one weather record into the retained weather table, or finishes the weather resolution and starts the precompute.

arms.name: run_initialize_zones
arms.doc: 🪵️ Initializes the zone states of the simulation model.

arms.name: run_initialize_surfaces
arms.doc: 🔩️ Initializes the surface states of the simulation model.

arms.name: run_initialize_warmup_history
arms.doc: ⚙️ Initializes the warmup history of every zone.

arms.name: run_warmup_convergence
arms.doc: 🪛️ Checks the warmup convergence and starts the next warmup day or the run.

arms.name: run_start_run
arms.doc: 🔧️ Starts the run period after the warmup.

arms.name: run_zone_timestep
arms.doc: 🔨️ Runs one zone timestep of the run period.

arms.name: run_encode_output
arms.doc: 🪚️ Encodes the retained results into the output pack.
